entries.profile_scope: Hy-MT2 7B Q4_K_M experimental v8, one target per batch, real 268-cue SRT
entries.expected_invariant: A complete structurally valid SRT must still preserve device type, core mode, comparison frame, platform action and product item meaning in every target cue.
entries.last_outcome: The complete 7B natural draft has six high-confidence source-aware AI meaning findings in a 43-cue source-only-selected audit. Each cue has pinned private source/candidate hashes and authored paired controls; no human assessment or control model runs.

entries.profile_scope: Hy-MT2 1.8B Q4_K_M experimental v8, one target per batch, real 268-cue SRT
entries.expected_invariant: A one-line target repeated with embedded newlines must be rejected before checkpoint even when the model response ends normally and maps to the correct ID.
entries.last_outcome: The real 1.8B single-target run rejected a three-line repetition at cue 80 with 79 earlier cues durable and no output SRT. Six authored controls remain unrun on the model.
